# mistershell_scheduled_task_config (Data Source)

Reads existing backend-owned configuration without changing it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mistershell_scheduled_task_config" "existing" {
  task_type = "telemetry_data_cleanup"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Existing numeric ID, stable configuration key, or local.
- `task_type` (String) Exact unique lookup instead of numeric id. When both are supplied they must identify the same object.

### Read-Only

- `configuration` (Dynamic, Sensitive) configuration fields: task_name, is_enabled, interval_minutes (>=1), timeout_seconds (60..86400), config (object or null), next_run (RFC3339 timestamp or null). next_run is a moving scheduler value; configuring it enforces that timestamp. Masked secrets are returned as null.
